rule: Requests for Zoom Webinar licenses, setup, or recordings are routed to lms-canvas.
Network, VPN, wifi, and ethernet connectivity issues in buildings or apartments are routed to telecom-network.
Issues with desk phones, dial tones, voicemail lights, and office phone extensions are routed to telecom-network.
Rosters, student enrollments, grade syncing between Canvas and Banner, and academic records are routed to registrar-systems.
Device registration for residence halls like Aspen, Cedar Commons, Elmhurst, Dunmore, and Birchwood is routed to resnet.
Requests for high-performance computing clusters, research storage quotas, and research software licenses are routed to research-computing.
Course evaluation link or page errors are routed to research-computing.
Classroom audio-visual issues involving projectors, Panopto recordings, and podium computers in specific rooms are routed to classroom-av.
Account authentication, password resets, Duo multi-factor authentication, and mailbox quota issues are routed to identity-access.
Financial aid portal, FAFSA codes, tuition payment plans, and aid disbursements are routed to financial-aid-systems.
Accessibility tools like CART captioning, Read&Write, ZoomText, JAWS, and alternative textbook formats are routed to accessibility-tech.
Campus printing fees, Pharos charges, copy center services, poster printing, and jammed campus printers are routed to print-services.
Reports of suspicious emails, phishing links, malware alerts, and compromised accounts are routed to security-phishing.
Hardware maintenance and software installations for labs in the East zone such as Okafor, Brightwater, and Halvorsen are routed to lab-desktop-east.
Hardware maintenance and software installations for labs in the West zone such as Ridgeway, Castellanos, and Tamarack are routed to lab-desktop-west.
Requests for shared mailbox permissions, administrative form authorizations, and name changes on accounts are routed to identity-access.
